patches.title: Edge-to-edge window
patches.detail: Remove the window's frame border so the page meets the window's edges.

patches.title: Square window corners
patches.detail: Square the window's corners instead of the rounded corners Windows 11 draws.

patches.title: Hide toolbar
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. Dia's toolbar is compiled XAML inside a detached content island, and Windows gives no supported way to reach it from outside.

patches.title: Reveal toolbar on hover
patches.detail: Not available on Windows, because it builds on Hide toolbar.

patches.title: Show toolbar with the sidebar
patches.detail: Not available on Windows, because it builds on Hide toolbar.

patches.title: Show toolbar on new tab pages
patches.detail: Not available on Windows, because it builds on Hide toolbar.

patches.title: Always show address field
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. The address field is compiled XAML with no reachable runtime tree.

patches.title: Hide sidebar button
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. The sidebar toggle is a XAML element in Dia's navigation bar, which can't be reached at runtime.

patches.title: Hide Chat button
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. The Chat button is a XAML element in Dia's navigation bar, which can't be reached at runtime.

patches.title: Hide Chats button
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. The Chats button is drawn by Dia's own XAML sidebar.

patches.title: Hide recent tabs button
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. The recent tabs button is drawn by Dia's own XAML sidebar.

patches.title: Keep the display awake
patches.detail: Stop the screen from sleeping while Dia is open. This is the Windows adaptation of the macOS tweak, which kept an unfocused window looking active.

patches.title: Allow iCloud passkeys
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. It relays passkey requests to Apple Passwords, which only exists on Apple platforms. Windows uses Windows Hello instead.

patches.title: Allow iCloud Passwords
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. It bridges to Apple's iCloud Passwords extension and native messaging host, which are macOS-only.
